def-hyp(__list__(
  LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace),
  Type.annotation(@V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type)
), LA.VectorSpace(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), __enum__[enumerate](
  member[colon](LA.Law.addCommutative, Logic.forall-typed(__list__(@a, @b), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add(a, b), LA.Add(b, a)))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addAssociative, Logic.forall-typed(__list__(@a, @b, @c), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add(a, LA.Add[paren](b, c)), LA.Add(LA.Add[paren](a, b), c)))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addIdentity, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add(a, LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), a))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addInverse, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.exists-typed(@b, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add(a, b), LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulAssociative, Logic.forall-typed(__list__(@k, @l), $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul(k, LA.Smul[paren](l, a)), LA.Smul(parentheses(Algebra.mul[juxt](k,l)), a))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulDistribVector, Logic.forall-typed(@k, $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(__list__(@a, @b), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul(k, LA.Add[paren](a, b)), LA.Add(LA.Smul(k, a), LA.Smul(k, b)))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulDistribScalar, Logic.forall-typed(__list__(@k, @l), $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul(parentheses(Add.add(k,l)), a), LA.Add(LA.Smul(k, a), LA.Smul(l, a)))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulIdentity, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul($1$, a), a)))
))

values.zh-CN: $V$ 是 $\mathbb{K}$ 上满足八条标准公理的线性空间；加法和数乘由各自的二元运算宏表示。
values.en: $V$ is a vector space over $\mathbb{K}$ satisfying the eight standard axioms; addition and scalar multiplication use dedicated binary operation macros.
